Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the packet and the follow-ups. We're still reviewing internally. Two concrete blockers that came up during our security/legal triage:

1) Data retention and deletion: our legal team needs a clear statement on retention defaults and an explanation of customer-controlled deletion options for private deployments (we couldn't find a single-line summary in the packet).

2) Auditor contact: our SOC 2 reviewer asked for the auditor firm's contact and the date range covered by the report (we saw the letter but don't have the auditor contact info).

Both are straightforward to fix — could you provide a one-paragraph retention summary and the auditor contact + covered dates? Also, Priya and I are available for a 30-minute call Tuesday or Wednesday between 10–12 PT to walk through — does that work for your team?

Appreciate the quick help.

Best,
Alex Chen
Senior Security Program Manager | Brightline Health

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clarity — totally understandable. I've pasted answers below and booked a 30-minute slot for Tuesday at 10:30 AM PT (invite sent). If that doesn't work, please suggest an alternate in that window.

Retention summary (one paragraph you can share with legal): Redwood Inference retains inference logs and minimal request metadata by default for 30 days to support billing and abuse detection. For Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, customers can opt into a zero-retention mode where logs and KV caches are not retained beyond request lifetime; retention settings are configurable at the tenant level and enforced via customer-managed keys and audit logs. Deletion requests are handled via our support portal with a defined SLA; a written deletion confirmation can be provided for compliance purposes.

Auditor contact and scope: Audit performed by Northbridge Compliance LLP; report covers Jan 1, 2026–Dec 31, 2026. Primary auditor contact: Claire Donovan, claire.donovan@northbridgecompliance.com.

I've attached a one-page annotated summary for legal and re-attached the packet.
